units.title: The truncated second moment of a Gaussian row
units.reader_note: Open the assumptions and source steps for the exact objects and Lean.
units.statement: At the cutoff \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\), the retained standard-Gaussian second moment is \(aI_r\).
assumptions: Let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\) satisfy \(2q+1<d\), and set \(r=q+1\). The case \(q=0\) has \(r=1\).
The row has the canonical law \(Z\sim N(0,I_r)\), with \(R=\|Z\|^2\). Retain the closed event \(R\le L\).

The expectation uses the original Gaussian measure. The coefficient \(a\) is the retained radial moment divided by \(r\). Both matrix integrability conclusions are proved using the Euclidean operator norm.

For the private application use \(\theta_j=(j-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(j=1,\ldots,d\), and \(t_j=(1,\sqrt2\cos\theta_j,\ldots,\sqrt2\cos(q\theta_j))\). Lean uses \(j=i.val+1\) for \(i\in\mathrm{Fin}(d)\) and zero-based feature frequencies.

steps.title: Establish the scalar and matrix integrals
steps.text: The canonical Gaussian squared-norm moment is integrable. Restrict it to the retained ball. Every retained coordinate product is dominated by that retained squared radius. Finite coordinate integrability and the continuous linear equivalence from arrays to matrices give the matrix integral and its entrywise evaluation.
steps.formula: |Z_kZ_\ell|\mathbf1_{\{R\le L\}}\le R\mathbf1_{\{R\le L\}},\qquad R\mathbf1_{\{R\le L\}}\in L^1.
steps.lean:
classical
  dsimp only
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let μ : Measure E := stdGaussian E
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let R : E → ℝ := fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let a : ℝ := (∫ x, Set.indicator {y : E | R y ≤ L} R x ∂μ) / r
  let G : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun x => Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp x)
  let good : Set E := {x | R x ≤ L}
  let kept : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := good.indicator G
  let entry (i j : Fin (q + 1)) (x : E) : ℝ := kept x i j
  have good_measurable : MeasurableSet good := by
    dsimp [good, R]
    exact measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) measurable_const
  have radius_integrable : Integrable R μ :=
    (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.StdGaussianMoment.integrable_norm_sq_and_integral_stdGaussian
      (E := E)).1
  have entry_formula (i j : Fin (q + 1)) :
      entry i j = good.indicator (fun x : E => x i * x j) := by
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ good <;> simp [entry, kept, G, Matrix.vecMulVec, hx]
  have retained_radius_integrable : Integrable (good.indicator R) μ :=
    radius_integrable.indicator good_measurable
  have entry_integrable (i j : Fin (q + 1)) : Integrable (entry i j) μ := by
    rw [entry_formula]
    have continuous_product : Continuous (fun x : E => x i * x j) :=
      (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => ℝ) i).mul
        (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => ℝ) j)
    apply retained_radius_integrable.mono'
      (continuous_product.aestronglyMeasurable.indicator good_measurable)
    filter_upwards with x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ good
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      calc
        ‖x i * x j‖ = ‖x i‖ * ‖x j‖ := norm_mul _ _
        _ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖x‖ :=
          mul_le_mul (PiLp.norm_apply_le x i) (PiLp.norm_apply_le x j)
            (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = R x := by simp [R, pow_two]
    · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
  let rows : E → Fin (q + 1) → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun x i j => entry i j x
  have rows_integrable : Integrable rows μ :=
    Integrable.of_eval (fun i => Integrable.of_eval (fun j => entry_integrable i j))
  let ofRows : (Fin (q + 1) → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ]
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    (Matrix.ofLinearEquiv ℝ).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have kept_integrable : Integrable kept μ := by
    change Integrable (fun x => ofRows (rows x)) μ
    exact ofRows.toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp rows_integrable
  have integral_entry (i j : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∫ x, kept x ∂μ) i j = ∫ x, entry i j x ∂μ := by
    have transport := ofRows.integral_comp_comm rows (μ := μ)
    change (∫ x, kept x ∂μ) = ofRows (∫ x, rows x ∂μ) at transport
    rw [transport]
    change ((∫ x, rows x ∂μ) i) j = _
    rw [MeasureTheory.eval_integral (fun i => rows_integrable.eval i) i]
    exact MeasureTheory.eval_integral (fun j => entry_integrable i j) j

steps.title: Cancel the off-diagonal entries
steps.text: A linear isometry preserves the standard Gaussian law and the radial cutoff. Flip the sign of coordinate k while keeping a distinct coordinate fixed. The corresponding retained product changes sign, so its expectation is zero.
steps.lean:
have invariant_integral (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (i j : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∫ x, entry i j (e x) ∂μ) = ∫ x, entry i j x ∂μ := by
    have law : Measure.map e μ = μ := stdGaussian_map e
    have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (entry i j) (Measure.map e μ) := by
      rw [law]
      exact (entry_integrable i j).aestronglyMeasurable
    have transport := integral_map e.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable hmeas
    rw [law] at transport
    exact transport.symm

  -- A sign change cancels every off-diagonal entry.
  have off_diagonal (i j : Fin (q + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
      (∫ x, entry i j x ∂μ) = 0 := by
    let flip : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E :=
      LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrRight 2 fun k : Fin (q + 1) =>
        if k = i then LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ else LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ
    have flip_apply (x : E) (k : Fin (q + 1)) :
        flip x k = if k = i then -x k else x k := by
      change (if k = i then (LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ : ℝ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ℝ)
        else LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ) (x k) = _
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    have flip_entry (x : E) : entry i j (flip x) = -entry i j x := by
      simp only [entry_formula]
      have radius_eq : R (flip x) = R x := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) (flip.norm_map x)
      by_cases hx : x ∈ good
      · have hfx : flip x ∈ good := by simpa [good, radius_eq] using hx
        simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Set.indicator_of_mem hfx, flip_apply, hij.symm]
      · have hfx : flip x ∉ good := by simpa [good, radius_eq] using hx
        simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, Set.indicator_of_notMem hfx]
    have h := invariant_integral flip i j
    simp_rw [flip_entry] at h
    rw [integral_neg] at h
    linarith

steps.title: Identify a common diagonal expectation
steps.text: The coordinate-swap isometry preserves the law and retained event. It interchanges the squared coordinates in the integral. The equality holds for every pair of indices and includes the single-coordinate case.
steps.lean:
-- Swapping two coordinates makes all diagonal expectations equal.
  have diagonal_equal (i j : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∫ x, entry i i x ∂μ) = ∫ x, entry j j x ∂μ := by
    let swap : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E :=
      LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℝ ℝ (Equiv.swap i j)
    have swap_apply (x : E) : swap x i = x j := by
      change x ((Equiv.swap i j).symm i) = x j
      simp
    have swap_entry (x : E) : entry i i (swap x) = entry j j x := by
      simp only [entry_formula]
      have radius_eq : R (swap x) = R x := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) (swap.norm_map x)
      by_cases hx : x ∈ good
      · have hsx : swap x ∈ good := by simpa [good, radius_eq] using hx
        simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Set.indicator_of_mem hsx, swap_apply]
      · have hsx : swap x ∉ good := by simpa [good, radius_eq] using hx
        simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, Set.indicator_of_notMem hsx]
    have h := invariant_integral swap i i
    simp_rw [swap_entry] at h
    exact h.symm

steps.title: Use the trace to determine the coefficient
steps.text: Write c for the common diagonal expectation. The sum of squared coordinates is R. Integrating this finite sum gives r c equal to the retained radial expectation. Divide by the positive dimension and combine the diagonal and off-diagonal entries.
steps.formula: r c=\mathbb E[R\mathbf1_{\{R\le L\}}],\qquad c=a,\qquad \mathbb E[ZZ^\top\mathbf1_{\{R\le L\}}]=aI_r.
steps.lean:
-- The trace is the retained squared radius, so its coefficient is a.
  have trace_pointwise (x : E) :
      (∑ i : Fin (q + 1), entry i i x) = good.indicator R x := by
    simp_rw [entry_formula]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ good
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      simpa [R, pow_two] using (EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq x).symm
    · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
  have trace_integral :
      (∑ i : Fin (q + 1), ∫ x, entry i i x ∂μ) = ∫ x, good.indicator R x ∂μ := by
    rw [← integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => entry_integrable i i)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall trace_pointwise
  have r_positive : 0 < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos q
  have diagonal_value (i : Fin (q + 1)) : (∫ x, entry i i x ∂μ) = a := by
    have trace_eq := trace_integral
    have sum_equal :
        (∑ j : Fin (q + 1), ∫ x, entry j j x ∂μ) = r * (∫ x, entry i i x ∂μ) := by
      simp_rw [diagonal_equal _ i]
      simp [r]
    rw [sum_equal] at trace_eq
    change (∫ x, entry i i x ∂μ) = (∫ x, good.indicator R x ∂μ) / r
    apply (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt r_positive)).2
    nlinarith [trace_eq]
  refine ⟨kept_integrable, ?_⟩
  change (∫ x, kept x ∂μ) = a • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ)
  ext i j
  rw [integral_entry]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simpa using diagonal_value i
  · simpa [hij] using off_diagonal i j

steps.title: Compute the actual matrix summand mean
steps.text: For a fixed source row, tensoring with its deterministic rank-one feature matrix and scaling by 1/d form a continuous linear map. The map commutes with the retained indicator and Bochner integral. Apply both components of the producer to obtain integrability and the exact mean. This fold contains the complete private application.
steps.formula: \begin{aligned}Y_i&=\frac1d(ZZ^\top\otimes t_it_i^\top)\mathbf1_{\{R\le L\}},\\\mathbb E Y_i&=\frac ad(I_r\otimes t_it_i^\top).\end{aligned}
steps.lean:
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumTruncatedRowMoment

/-!
# The actual expected truncated Gaussian matrix summand

This source application uses the one-row second moment and the deterministic
midpoint cosine feature. All matrix integrals use the Euclidean operator norm.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityFixedSpectrumTruncatedRowMoment

open AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumTruncatedRowMoment

private theorem actual_truncated_matrix_summand_mean
    {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) (i : Fin d) :
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let μ : Measure E := stdGaussian E
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let R : E → ℝ := fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let a : ℝ := (∫ x, Set.indicator {y : E | R y ≤ L} R x ∂μ) / r
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun j => ((j.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun j k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ j)
  let G : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun x => Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp x)
  let Y : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    Set.indicator {y : E | R y ≤ L}
      (fun x => (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (G x) (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)))
  Integrable Y μ ∧
    (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) =
      (a / (d : ℝ)) • Matrix.kronecker
        (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let μ : Measure E := stdGaussian E
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let R : E → ℝ := fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let a : ℝ := (∫ x, Set.indicator {y : E | R y ≤ L} R x ∂μ) / r
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun j => ((j.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun j k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ j)
  let G : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun x => Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp x)
  let good : Set E := {y : E | R y ≤ L}
  let kept : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := good.indicator G
  let Y : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    good.indicator
      (fun x => (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (G x) (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)))
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let N := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let feature : M := Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)
  let tensor : M →ₗ[ℝ] N :=
    (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear : M →ₗ[ℝ] M →ₗ[ℝ] N).flip feature
  let scaled : M →L[ℝ] N := (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • tensor.toContinuousLinearMap
  have moment := actual_truncated_row_second_moment (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change Integrable kept μ ∧ (∫ x, kept x ∂μ) = a • (1 : M) at moment
  have summand_as_linear_image : Y = fun x => scaled (kept x) := by
    funext x
    change good.indicator (fun x => (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (G x) feature) x =
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (good.indicator G x) feature
    by_cases hx : x ∈ good
    · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
    · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
  change Integrable Y μ ∧
    (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) = (a / (d : ℝ)) • Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) feature
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [summand_as_linear_image]
    exact scaled.integrable_comp moment.1
  · calc
      (∫ x, Y x ∂μ) = scaled (∫ x, kept x ∂μ) := by
        rw [summand_as_linear_image]
        exact scaled.integral_comp_comm moment.1
      _ = scaled (a • (1 : M)) := congrArg scaled moment.2
      _ = a • scaled (1 : M) := scaled.map_smul a (1 : M)
      _ = (a / (d : ℝ)) • Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) feature := by
        change a • ((d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) feature) = _
        simp only [smul_smul, div_eq_mul_inv]

end AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityFixedSpectrumTruncatedRowMoment

units.dependency_notes: The producer consumes integrability from the canonical Gaussian norm moment. Gaussian isometry invariance, finite-dimensional matrix integration and the trace identify the matrix. The private application consumes the producer through a continuous linear Kronecker map.
units.lean_statement: Integrability and the exact retained second moment under the actual standard row law.
units.lean_proof: Prove entry integrability, use sign and coordinate symmetries, determine the trace coefficient, and transport through the deterministic tensor map.
units.boundary: The exact canonical single-row truncated second moment and the actual deterministic-row Y mean are compiled. The original joint row-family pushforward and integral transport, aggregate cosine-frame means, centered bounds, fourth moments, matrix concentration, full Lemma 4.4, both main lower bounds and oracle/precision/cost adapters are separate. Independent source/native review, public integration, complete desktop/mobile reader acceptance and purification are pending.
